name: markifact
description: Run Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, Shopify, HubSpot and 20+ more platforms from Cursor. Audit spend, launch campaigns, rotate creative, and pull reporting, with approval required before anything goes live.

default_account_label.title: Default account label
default_account_label.description: Optional. A short label (e.g. "Acme US") that the agent should assume when you don't specify which connection to use. Leave empty to be asked every time.

preferred_currency.title: Preferred currency
preferred_currency.description: Optional ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP) used when summarising spend and revenue.

default_platforms.title: Default platforms
default_platforms.description: Comma-separated list of platforms you actively manage (e.g. "google_ads,meta_ads,ga4"). The agent will prioritize these when discovering operations. Leave empty to consider all connected platforms.
